backrooms.description: Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.
